description: Land Acquisition - Pitipana-North, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including their boundaries, extents, and survey details. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke) issuing the order, the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification rules.
